tagline.en: From the Taiwan Strait to the Sichuan basin across six provinces, finished in 2017
tagline.zh: 自台湾海峡横穿六省直抵四川盆地，2017 年全线贯通

start.en: Haicang port, Xiamen, at Jiaosong Road
start.zh: 福建省厦门市海沧区角嵩路（海沧港务）

end.en: The Chengyu interchange on Chengdu's Third Ring Road, at Shuangqiaozi
end.zh: 四川省成都市三环路成渝立交（双桥子）

en: G76 is one of the east–west lines of the national expressway network: 2,143 km as planned, from the port of Xiamen on the Taiwan Strait to Chengdu. It runs through Zhangzhou and Longyan in Fujian, Ruijin and Ganzhou in Jiangxi, Chenzhou in southern Hunan, Guilin in Guangxi, then Duyun, Guiyang and Bijie in Guizhou, and Luzhou and Neijiang in Sichuan.

It is a road across the grain of southern China. From the coast it climbs into the hills of western Fujian, crosses the Nanling ranges between Jiangxi, Hunan and Guangxi, and then spends its longest provincial stretch — more than 600 km — on the Guizhou plateau before dropping to the Yangtze at Luzhou. In several places it shares the carriageway with other national routes: with the Baotou–Maoming and Quanzhou–Nanning expressways around Guilin, with the Shanghai–Kunming expressway on the Guiyang ring, and with the Hangzhou–Ruili expressway near Bijie.
zh: G76 是国家高速公路网的东西横线之一：规划全长 2143 公里，自台湾海峡边的厦门港直抵成都。途经福建漳州、龙岩，江西瑞金、赣州，湖南郴州，广西桂林，贵州都匀、贵阳、毕节，四川泸州、内江。
这是一条横切中国南方山势的路。它从海岸爬进闽西山地，在赣、湘、桂之间翻越南岭，随后在贵州高原上走完全线最长的一个省段——六百多公里——才下到长江边的泸州。它有多段与其他国家高速共线：在桂林一带与包茂高速、泉南高速共线，在贵阳绕城与沪昆高速共线，在毕节附近与杭瑞高速共线。

en: The hardest ground is in southern Hunan. On the 112 km Rucheng–Chenzhou section, bridges and tunnels make up roughly half the length; it has 86 bridges and 29 tunnels. Its key structure is the Chishi Bridge at Yizhang, a four-pylon cable-stayed concrete bridge with a 1,470 m main bridge and a 380 m main span, its deck 186 m above the valley floor and its pylons 259.63 to 286.63 m tall. The karst under it gave no bearing stratum for the foundations, and the design went through nine expert reviews; the deepest pile is 102.8 m.

The Fujian end has its own reputation. The Zhangzhou–Longyan section, opened in 2004 as a four-lane road designed mostly for 80 km/h, includes a continuous 14 km downhill at Hexi. By the end of 2012 the accident-prone stretches had seen more than 1,300 crashes. The widening that began in 2014 keeps the old line as the uphill carriageway towards Longyan and builds a new, gentler line for traffic towards Zhangzhou, taking the road to eight lanes over 126 km.

The Xiamen section, 18 km, is two-thirds viaduct and tunnel, and passes under the Yingtan–Xiamen railway in the Dongfu tunnel. In Guizhou, the Zhijin–Nayong section crosses the Wuzuo River and Nayong on major bridges; in Sichuan, the road enters from Guizhou over the Chishui River bridge.
zh: 最难的路段在湘南。汝城至郴州段长 112 公里，桥隧约占一半，有桥梁 86 座、隧道 29 座。其控制性工程是宜章县的赤石特大桥：四塔双索面预应力混凝土斜拉桥，主桥长 1470 米，主跨 380 米，桥面距谷底 186 米，四座主塔高 259.63 至 286.63 米。桥位处岩溶发育，找不到桥墩所需的持力层，设计方案经过 9 次专家评审才获通过；最深的桩基达 102.8 米。
福建一端另有名声。漳州至龙岩段 2004 年通车，为双向四车道、设计时速大多为 80 公里，其中和溪段有长达 14 公里的连续下坡。至 2012 年底，事故集中路段已发生 1300 多起事故。2014 年启动的扩建工程把旧线改为往龙岩方向的上行线，另建一条坡度较缓的复线供往漳州方向行驶，126 公里路段扩为双向八车道。
厦门段长 18 公里，三分之二为高架桥和隧道，并以东孚隧道下穿鹰厦铁路。贵州织金至纳雍段以武佐河大桥、纳雍特大桥跨越深谷；入川处则经赤水河大桥与贵州段相接。

en: The oldest piece is in Sichuan. The Chengdu–Chongqing Expressway, Sichuan's first, was begun in 1990 and its Chengdu–Longchang part, 201 km, was through by 1 July 1995; that stretch now carries G76. The Longchang–Naxi road to Luzhou followed between 1996 and 2000.

Most of the rest was built province by province in the 2000s and 2010s. Fujian opened Zhangzhou–Longyan in December 2004 and Longyan–Changting in December 2007. Jiangxi finished Ruijin–Ganzhou at the end of 2009 and its last section, Ganzhou–Chongyi, in December 2012. Hunan opened all three of its sections on 23 December 2012 — except the Chishi Bridge, which followed on 28 October 2016. Guizhou's Bijie–Shengji section opened in November 2015, and Sichuan's Naxi–Guizhou border section in November 2012.

The last gap was in northern Guangxi. On 26 October 2017 the Guilin–Sanjiang section opened, and with it the whole of G76. On 24 June 2025 a rain-triggered landslide brought down part of the approach span of the Houzi River bridge in Sandu, Guizhou.
zh: 最早建成的一段在四川。成渝高速公路是四川第一条高速公路，1990 年开工，其中成都至隆昌段 201 公里于 1995 年 7 月 1 日贯通，今为 G76 所用。隆昌至泸州纳溪的隆纳高速随后于 1996 至 2000 年建成。

其余路段大多在 2000 年代和 2010 年代由各省分段修建。福建漳龙段 2004 年 12 月通车，龙长段 2007 年 12 月通车。江西瑞赣段 2009 年底建成，最后一段赣崇段 2012 年 12 月通车。湖南三段于 2012 年 12 月 23 日同时通车，唯赤石特大桥延至 2016 年 10 月 28 日。贵州毕生段 2015 年 11 月通车，四川纳黔段 2012 年 11 月全线通车。
最后的缺口在桂北。2017 年 10 月 26 日，桂林至三江段通车，标志着厦蓉高速全线贯通。2025 年 6 月 24 日，贵州三都县猴子河特大桥引桥因降雨诱发山体滑坡而部分垮塌。

en: There is no published cost for the whole route; each province priced and financed its own sections. Some of those prices are public: the 135 km Longyan–Changting section cost 6.14 billion yuan; the 117 km Ruijin–Ganzhou section was budgeted at 5.62 billion, of which US$200 million was a World Bank loan; Hunan's Rucheng–Chenzhou section was budgeted at 9.64 billion and the Chishi Bridge alone at about 1.39 billion; Sichuan's Naxi–Guizhou border section at 10.75 billion. The 2014 widening of the Fujian mountain sections was budgeted at 13.5 billion.
It is a toll road, except for the stretch of the Xiamen section east of the Xiamen West main toll station, which is free.
zh: 全线没有公布总造价；各省自行概算、自行筹资修建本省路段。部分路段的数字是公开的：龙长段 135 公里，总投资 61.379 亿元；瑞赣段 117 公里，概算 56.2 亿元，其中世界银行贷款 2 亿美元；湖南汝郴段概算 96.4 亿元，其中赤石特大桥一座约 13.87 亿元；四川纳黔段概算 107.53 亿元。2014 年启动的福建山区路段扩建工程概算 135 亿元。
全线收费，唯厦门段中厦门西主线收费站以东的路段免费。

en: The Xiamen section is limited to 100 km/h; the Chishi Bridge and the old Fujian mountain line were designed for 80. Coming down from Longyan towards Zhangzhou, the long Hexi grade is the stretch to treat with respect.
At the Sichuan–Guizhou border, the Chishui River exit can only be used by turning back on the road, which has made it known locally as the 'internet-famous exit'.
zh: 厦门段限速每小时 100 公里；赤石特大桥及福建山区旧线的设计时速为 80 公里。由龙岩下往漳州方向时，和溪长下坡是需要格外小心的路段。
川黔交界处的赤水河出口须掉头才能使用，因此被称为“网红出口”。

why.en: No cost has been published for the route as a whole. Mainland national expressways are priced and financed section by section by the provinces; the sourced section costs are listed separately below.
why.zh: 全线总造价未见公布。大陆国家高速公路由各省分段概算、分段筹资，已查到来源的路段造价分列于下。

why.en: No route-wide funding statement exists; each province financed its own sections. The one outside lender documented here is the World Bank, on the Ruijin–Ganzhou section.
why.zh: 未见全线出资说明；各省分别为本省路段筹资。此处唯一查到的外部贷款方是世界银行，用于瑞金至赣州段。

timeline.en: The Chengdu–Longchang part of the Chengdu–Chongqing Expressway, Sichuan's first, is through on 1 July; it later becomes G76.
timeline.zh: 7 月 1 日，四川第一条高速公路成渝高速的成都至隆昌段贯通，日后成为 G76 的一部分。

timeline.en: The Longchang–Naxi expressway to Luzhou opens on 28 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 28 日，隆昌至泸州纳溪的隆纳高速全线通车。

timeline.en: Fujian's Zhangzhou–Longyan section opens on 28 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 28 日，福建漳龙段通车。

timeline.en: The Longyan–Changting section opens on 25 December.
Hunan opens its three sections on 23 December, all but the Chishi Bridge.
timeline.zh: 12 月 23 日，湖南三段同时通车，仅赤石特大桥未通。

timeline.en: Widening of the Fujian mountain sections to eight lanes begins.
timeline.zh: 福建漳龙、龙长段启动八车道扩建。

timeline.en: The Xiamen section's main line opens on 18 February; Guizhou's Bijie–Shengji section opens on 15 November.
timeline.zh: 2 月 18 日厦门段主线通车；11 月 15 日贵州毕生段通车。

timeline.en: The Chishi Bridge opens on 28 October, completing the Hunan section.
timeline.zh: 10 月 28 日，赤石特大桥通车，湖南段全线贯通。

timeline.en: The Guilin–Sanjiang section opens on 26 October, and with it the whole route.
timeline.zh: 10 月 26 日，桂林至三江段通车，厦蓉高速全线贯通。

timeline.en: A landslide brings down part of the Houzi River bridge approach in Sandu, Guizhou, on 24 June.
timeline.zh: 6 月 24 日，贵州三都县猴子河特大桥引桥因山体滑坡部分垮塌。
